description: This file declares functions related to autograd (automatic differentiation) in the PyTorch library. It provides functions for computing gradients and managing differentiation levels, serving as a key interface for autograd in the C++ frontend. The file includes detailed documentation for each function, indicating it is a header file for defining API functions.

methods.name: backward
methods.description: Computes the sum of gradients of given tensors with respect to graph leaves, supporting optional gradient tensors, graph retention, and higher-order derivatives.

methods.name: grad
methods.description: Calculates and returns the sum of gradients of outputs with respect to inputs, supporting options for gradient outputs, graph retention, higher-order derivatives, and handling unused inputs.

methods.name: enter_dual_level
methods.description: Creates a new dual level for nested forward automatic differentiation, returning its index.

methods.name: exit_dual_level
methods.description: Exits the given dual level, clearing gradients and reverting dual tensors to regular tensors, should be called in reverse order of entering.
